Leadership Combat Styles

Choose Leadership perks to bolster allies or improve nearby party attacks.

Leadership - Vanguard Command

Vanguard Command includes an aura that increases nearby party members' damage for a limited time.

Leadership - Field Steward

Field Steward includes ally-focused temporary protection and stronger protection for an ally at low health.
